boundedQuestion: Can honest Candidate/unverified labels make a coarse self-created excavator a legitimate learning or replication result when the user supplied a complete excavator reference?

productionFeedback.losslessSummary: The user ordered this version deleted and objected that a complete excavator had already been supplied, but the result did not learn it and instead presented an unacceptable substitute.

evidence.observation: Excavator tab presents a coarse analytic yellow/grey excavator. The UI truthfully says approximate observation, not a faithful finished model; mounting, underframe and wheels remain unverified; 122 coarse shapes are not 122 validated parts.
Bucket tab presents an isolated coarse function candidate and explicitly marks visible parts as candidates/not whole-machine accepted.
A second isolated function candidate is still marked as not device-accepted and is visually separate from a complete excavator replication.
This file is a model-generated bucket image, so it cannot by itself prove the identity or completeness of the user's original full-excavator reference set.

unknowns: Exact immutable identity/path/hash of the user-supplied complete excavator reference set
Production branch/head and source files that generated the observed web UI
Whether the coarse visible excavator was isolated as TEST_FIXTURE_ONLY or entered an active/user-visible lineage

gateRun.reason: Truthful Candidate/unverified labels prevent a false acceptance claim, but labels do not authorize a generic/coarse visible substitute. In REPLICATION_LOCKED mode, the visible excavator must still map to the supplied complete reference through source identity, coverage and per-delta evidence.

novelty.description: A result can be honest about being coarse and unverified yet still violate the reference-replication gate. Epistemic honesty and task fidelity are separate gates; passing the former cannot waive the latter.

minimumFalsifiableRecovery.hypothesis: If the next excavator candidate binds the exact supplied full-excavator reference identity, records part-level coverage/unknowns, and maps each visible excavator and bucket delta to reference evidence, then the creative-substitute rejection can be falsified without lowering visual quality or inventing missing structure.
required: Bind exact referenceSet identity and accepted baseline before visible work
Quarantine the rejected coarse visible result from parent/baseline selection
Select one bounded component or relation from the supplied complete excavator
Record visible/occluded/unknown coverage and per-delta evidence mapping
Run an independent fixed-view comparison on the current production head
Return NO_NEW_ARTIFACT if no legal candidate exists
minimumFalsifiableRecovery.falsifier: Any visible component remains generic, invented, source-unmapped, or descends from the rejected coarse result.

routing.target: actual excavator production Mother via issue 91 coordination
routing.requestedAction: Honor the user's delete direction by removing/quarantining this rejected version from active/public lineage while preserving failure history; restart only from an accepted/evidence-backed parent and the exact complete excavator reference.
routing.flywheelBoundary: No production Mother branch, asset, public route or baseline was modified by this learning run.
